title: Manage
description: Add tickers to the database and edit the weekly-email watchlist. The Business Forms panels write to Postgres; the app ingests queued tickers (minutely) and the weekly report reads the watchlist flag.

panels.title: Add ticker
panels.description: Queue a stock or crypto by its Yahoo-style symbol (e.g. NVDA, CSU.TO, XMR). Stocks are validated against SEC EDGAR and Yahoo Finance and get full price + fundamentals history; cryptocurrencies register from the <SYM>-USD Yahoo pair plus CoinGecko spot. Ingested within a minute or two — watch the status in Ticker requests.

payload.rawSql:
WITH candidate AS (
  SELECT upper(trim('${payload.symbol}')) AS symbol
)
INSERT INTO ticker_requests (symbol)
SELECT c.symbol
FROM candidate c
WHERE c.symbol ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9.=-]{0,31}$'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM instruments i WHERE i.symbol = c.symbol)
ON CONFLICT (symbol) DO UPDATE SET status = 'pending', note = NULL, processed_at = NULL

elements.title: Symbol
elements.tooltip: Stock or crypto, e.g. NVDA, CSU.TO, RMS.PA, XMR

panels.title: Ticker requests
panels.description: Recent add-ticker requests and their status (pending → done / not_found / error). Rows persist so re-adding is idempotent; the note explains each outcome.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.symbol AS "Ticker", r.status AS "Status", coalesce(r.note, '') AS "Note", r.requested_at AS "Requested", r.processed_at AS "Processed" FROM ticker_requests r ORDER BY r.requested_at DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Current watchlist
panels.description: Instruments on the weekly-email watchlist. When this is empty the email falls back to REPORT_SYMBOLS, then to every tracked instrument.

targets.rawSql: SELECT i.symbol AS "Symbol", i.name AS "Name", i.kind AS "Kind", i.currency AS "Currency" FROM instruments i WHERE i.in_watchlist ORDER BY i.symbol

panels.title: Add to watchlist
panels.description: Pick tracked instruments to add to the weekly-email watchlist.

payload.rawSql: UPDATE instruments SET in_watchlist = true WHERE upper(symbol) = ANY(string_to_array(replace(upper('${payload.symbols}'), ' ', ''), ','))

elements.title: Symbols
elements.tooltip: Comma-separated tickers, e.g. AAPL,BN — case- and space-insensitive

panels.title: Remove from watchlist
panels.description: Pick instruments to drop from the weekly-email watchlist.

payload.rawSql: UPDATE instruments SET in_watchlist = false WHERE upper(symbol) = ANY(string_to_array(replace(upper('${payload.symbols}'), ' ', ''), ','))

elements.title: Symbols
elements.tooltip: Comma-separated tickers, e.g. AAPL,BN — case- and space-insensitive

panels.title: Add account
panels.description: Create a portfolio account/label (e.g. a broker or exchange) to book holdings under. Also created automatically the first time you add a holding for a new account name.

payload.rawSql: INSERT INTO accounts (name) VALUES (trim('${payload.name}')) ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Known accounts and how many open lots each has.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.name AS "Account", COUNT(h.id) AS "Open lots"
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN holdings h ON h.account_id = a.id AND h.quantity_sold < h.quantity
GROUP BY a.name
ORDER BY a.name

panels.title: Add holding
panels.description: Add a lot: quantity + total cost basis, acquired in an account on a date. The instrument must already be tracked (add it as a ticker above first). A new account name is created automatically. Ingested into the Portfolio dashboard immediately — no ingest delay.

payload.rawSql:
WITH acct AS (
  INSERT INTO accounts (name)
  VALUES (trim('${payload.account}'))
  ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name
  RETURNING id
),
inst AS (
  SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE upper(symbol) = upper(trim('${payload.symbol}'))
)
INSERT INTO holdings (instrument_id, account_id, quantity, cost_basis, currency, acquired_at, note)
SELECT inst.id, acct.id, '${payload.quantity}'::numeric, '${payload.cost_basis}'::numeric,
       upper(trim('${payload.currency}')), '${payload.acquired_at}'::date,
       NULLIF(trim('${payload.note}'), '')
FROM inst, acct
WHERE inst.id IS NOT NULL

elements.title: Account
elements.tooltip: e.g. IBKR, Coinbase — created if new

elements.title: Cost basis (total)
elements.tooltip: Total amount paid for the whole lot, e.g. 1500.00

elements.title: Currency
elements.tooltip: 3-letter code the cost basis is in, e.g. USD

elements.title: Note (optional)
elements.tooltip: Free text, e.g. broker order id

panels.title: Open holdings
panels.description: Every open (or partially sold) lot. Note the ID — it is what the Reduce/close form below needs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT h.id AS "ID", i.symbol AS "Symbol", a.name AS "Account",
       (h.quantity - h.quantity_sold) AS "Open qty", h.quantity AS "Lot qty",
       h.cost_basis AS "Cost basis", h.currency AS "Currency", h.acquired_at AS "Acquired",
       coalesce(h.note, '') AS "Note"
FROM holdings h
JOIN instruments i ON i.id = h.instrument_id
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = h.account_id
WHERE h.quantity_sold < h.quantity
ORDER BY h.acquired_at DESC

panels.title: Reduce / close holding
panels.description: Record a sale (partial or full) against an existing lot — look up its ID in Open holdings above. Selling the remaining quantity closes the lot.

payload.rawSql:
UPDATE holdings
SET quantity_sold = quantity_sold + '${payload.quantity}'::numeric,
    proceeds = proceeds + '${payload.proceeds}'::numeric,
    last_sold_at = '${payload.sold_at}'::date
WHERE id = '${payload.holding_id}'::int
  AND (quantity_sold + '${payload.quantity}'::numeric) <= quantity

elements.title: Holding ID
elements.tooltip: From the Open holdings table above

elements.title: Quantity sold
elements.tooltip: Must not exceed what's left open

elements.title: Proceeds (total)
elements.tooltip: Total amount received for this sale

panels.title: Realized P/L (recent sales)
panels.description: Sales recorded from the form above, most recent first, converted to USD.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.symbol AS "Symbol", r.account_name AS "Account", r.quantity_sold AS "Qty sold",
       r.last_sold_at AS "Sold", r.realized_pl_usd AS "Realized P/L (USD)"
FROM portfolio_realized_pl r
ORDER BY r.last_sold_at DESC
LIMIT 15
